articles.title: Trump says Musk restored Ukraine’s Starlink access amid Russia war
articles.desc: Trump has declined to comment on the process that led Starlink to lift speed and access restrictions on Ukraine.

articles.title: Fusion CX debuts at 5.5% premium
articles.desc: Fusion CX shares were listed at ₹305 on the NSE. The issue was listed at a premium of 5.54% against the issue price of ₹289 per share. The stock closed at ₹289.65. The market capitalisation of the company was ₹4.18 crore on Thursday.

articles.title: Yes Bank AT1 Bonds: Why the Supreme Court Reversed the ₹8,415 Crore Write-Down
UBS Group AG acquires 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM after exercising warrants
articles.desc: In a notable development, UBS Group AG has secured a 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM by exercising warrants. This action comes over a year after UBS shifted its local wealth management operations to the company. The Swiss bank has now executed over 20.5 million warrants and fulfilled the payment obligation that began with a 25% down payment, marking a substantial investment in India.

articles.title: Nippon AMC gets Sebi nod for settlement in Yes Bank AT1 case
articles.desc: Nippon Life India Asset Management Company has obtained in-principle approval from Sebi regarding a settlement case involving mutual fund investments in Yes Bank's AT1 bonds. With a settlement payment of ₹96.8 crore, including management fee reversals, this comes after a show-cause notice was issued in August 2024 due to alleged non-compliance. The final ruling from Sebi is still anticipated by the company and its representatives.

articles.title: Yes Bank AT1 coupon due, bondholders seek clarity
articles.desc: YES Bank's bondholders have not received recent coupon payments which were due shortly after a court ruling. The Supreme Court restored the value of these bonds, raising uncertainty among investors. Bondholders have requested that the trustee clarify the status of unpaid coupons. Another coupon payment is also approaching, adding to the urgency of the situation. Bondholders expect payments to proceed in accordance with the court's ruling and official guidelines.

articles.title: Banking liquidity surplus shrinks to Rs 541 crore as cash crunch increases
articles.desc: Liquidity surplus in the banking system was reported at ₹541 crore as of October 21. Banks have increased fund parking to meet their daily cash reserve requirements of 99%. The weighted average call rate (WACR) rose to 5.65%, which is 15 bps higher than the repo rate. The Reserve Bank of India conducted variable rate repo operations to manage systemic liquidity.

articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks slide after US tech rout
articles.desc: MSCI Inc.’s regional equities benchmark slipped 0.3%, declining for a second day, leaving the gauge hovering around levels last seen in July. Taiwan’s stock exchange will be shut Friday due to a typhoon. Sentiment stayed weak as contracts for the Nasdaq 100 Index fell 0.3% in early Asian trading.

articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks slide after US tech rout
articles.desc: MSCI Inc.’s regional equities benchmark slipped 0.3%, declining for a second day, leaving the gauge hovering around levels last seen in July. Taiwan’s stock exchange will be shut Friday due to a typhoon. Sentiment stayed weak as contracts for the Nasdaq 100 Index fell 0.3% in early Asian trading.

articles.title: Sun Pharma falls short of bond fundraising target amid rising yields
articles.desc: Sun Pharma successfully secured ₹7,816 crore in its latest fundraising round, yet it fell short of its ambitious ₹10,000-crore target. The company opted for five- and seven-year bonds, pricing them at 8.05% and 8.20% respectively. A significant ₹2,100 crore was raised through anchor investments to bolster this effort, although rising market yields have made investors cautious about committing funds.

articles.title: Rupee declines first time in eight sessions as Brent oil prices rise above $112
articles.desc: On Thursday, the Indian rupee declined for the first time in eight trading sessions. This occurred even amid foreign portfolio investment inflows for the Jio Platforms IPO. Brent oil prices climbed to over $112 per barrel, contributing to the rupee's fall. Currency traders predict the rupee will trade between 94.50 and 95.25 on Friday. The Reserve Bank of India may intervene near 95 per dollar levels.

articles.title: Government plans to pare stakes in 4 PSU banks to 75%
articles.desc: The Union government announced in the 2021-22 budget that, besides IDBI Bank, it would take up two public sector banks and one general insurance company for privatisation.

articles.title: D-Street poised for a positive start as GIFT Nifty trades firmly higher
articles.desc: Indian equity benchmarks experienced a third consecutive session of declines due to selling pressure. Global cues remained weak, impacting market sentiment and performance. A recovery is possible if the index reclaims 22,800, while immediate support is at 22,600. Foreign institutional investors were net buyers, but the rupee fell against the dollar amid rising crude oil prices. Investors are advised to assess levels carefully as market volatility persists.

articles.title: Stocks in news: Swiggy, Infosys, HPCL, eMudhra, Adani Power, Shriram Finance, Tata Motors and NLC India
articles.desc: Indian equity markets faced continued downward pressure, marked by persistent selling and negative global indicators. The Nifty 50 index saw a decline, with analysts pointing out critical resistance and support points. Numerous companies disclosed their financial results, showcasing a mix of profits and setbacks for the September quarter. As various firms prepare to announce their quarterly earnings, market participants should remain vigilant over the coming days.

articles.title: Jio Platforms IPO subscribed 5.57 times on day 2 on strong interest
articles.desc: The Jio Platforms initial public offering has ignited substantial investor interest, achieving a remarkable 5.57 times subscription on the second day alone. Fully subscribed by retail investors, this reflects a strong demand, while institutional bidders have led the pack with a striking 13.29 times subscription rate. Proceeds from the IPO will support the repayment of debts and various corporate initiatives, remaining open for subscriptions until Friday.

articles.title: IPO-bound companies defer launches to avoid Jio mega issue
articles.desc: The anticipated IPO of Jio Platforms is set to reshape the primary market, prompting several firms to defer their upcoming launches to sidestep investor competition. While only Paras Healthcare's offering is currently active, nine other IPOs managed to secure funding in October. Post-Jio's close in late October, November is expected to witness a flurry of activity, with around 15 IPOs lined up for that month.

articles.title: Financials, FMCG lead FPI sell-off; IT stocks buck the trend in first half of October
articles.desc: In the early days of October, there was a notable retreat of foreign portfolio investors from several sectors, particularly in financial services and FMCG, which saw outflows of ₹8,634 crore and ₹8,172 crore respectively. Conversely, IT stocks caught a breath of investment, attracting ₹2,599 crore as they turned a new page in investor sentiment.

articles.title: Etsy is cracking down on AI slop listings
articles.desc: Etsy is announcing stricter rules about how AI can be used in listings to reduce the volume of AI slop on the platform. In a post, the company says that "many active buyers say they can't tell which items involve AI-generated content" and that sellers are "concerned about your work appearing alongside items that use […]

articles.title: Iran war live: Trump hints new strikes, says US knocked ‘hell out’ of Iran
articles.desc: Trump indicates new strikes on Iran, saying the US has knocked the 'hell out' of the country.

articles.title: I thought I was dying but it was health anxiety - here's how to recognise the signs
articles.desc: Hollie Sharman shares her experience of health anxiety and a doctor advises on how to manage symptoms.

articles.title: Surveillance and 'constant paranoia': Western diplomats tell BBC of life in war-time Moscow
articles.desc: Officials compare working in Russia since its full-scale invasion of Ukraine to the Cold War era.

articles.title: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC investigation finds
articles.desc: The UN human rights chief Volker Türk says the multiple attacks may amount to war crimes.

articles.title: US-sanctioned ICC wins Sakharov Prize, EU’s top human rights award
articles.desc: The prize comes less than two weeks after US President Donald Trump announced sanctions against the court.

articles.title: Ecuador opposition leader Luisa Gonzalez arrested in campaign finance probe
articles.desc: Gonzalez’s Citizen Revolution Movement has denounced the arrest as politically motivated, calling for her release.

articles.title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
articles.desc: Canva is diving even deeper into AI with the launch of an image generation model that competes directly with those from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google. The model, called Canva Craft, uses a two-stage architecture that allows it to plan a design before generating an image, allowing for "greater precision, consistency and control," according to an […]

articles.title: Trump says Musk has restored access to Ukraine's Starlink network
articles.desc: Ukraine relies on Starlink for a range of military uses - its owner Elon Musk has repeatedly denied restricting access.

articles.title: Fall 2026 earnings watch
articles.desc: Every company is suddenly an AI company. Compute is an asset. Cars are flying. We’ve been promised robots — again. It’s time again to dig through earnings reports, listen to investor calls, and call out the latest wins and losses from around the tech sector and what it means for where the companies go next.

articles.title: IEA chief warns energy is becoming a geopolitical weapon
articles.desc: Dr. Fatih Birol, Executive Director of the IEA, warns that energy is becoming a geopolitical weapon.

articles.title: Meta’s AI could still scrape news sites, legal experts say
articles.desc: Meta has tweaked its business terms to remove language suggesting that it could freely train its AI models on news sites, like The Verge - but legal experts say these changes aren't enough to address their concerns. "This does nothing to restrict the 'associated with your products or services' [language] that would let Meta scrape […]

articles.title: Meta turns Muse sharing back on
articles.desc: Meta has re-enabled Muse sharing after security researchers had reported that public conversation links could be easy to find. The researchers said they had been able to find Muse pages like a marketing company's internal revenue review and a small business owner's loan application. Researchers at Claroc reported earlier this week that Muse the web […]

articles.title: The FCC is beginning to block gadgets with ‘foreign surveillance chips’
articles.desc: On October 13th, Brendan Carr's FCC gave itself a new power - it can block gadgets for containing any computer chip made by any company on its list of potential threats to national security. Today, it's exercising that power for the first time, blocking two gadgets because they contain "foreign surveillance chips," the FCC claims. […]

articles.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq slumps 2.5%, S&P 1% as revived AI doubts ignite tech selloff
articles.desc: US stocks fell sharply as renewed concerns over massive AI spending triggered a selloff in technology and semiconductor shares. The Nasdaq suffered its steepest one day decline since June, while the S&P 500 also dropped. Tesla and Meta fell, while oil prices climbed to a five-month high amid fresh Middle East tensions.

articles.title: Moderna stock crashes 25%, loses about $24 billion after cancer vaccine data leak
articles.desc: Moderna’s stock price dropped over 25% after trial results for its personalized melanoma vaccine with Merck were disclosed. The decline erased approximately $24 billion from Moderna’s market value, ending a significant rally this year. Analysts noted that this reaction was expected as investors often sell after news becomes public. Despite the drop, the trial results showed promising reductions in cancer recurrence when paired with Merck's Keytruda.

articles.title: Sure, let’s smoosh SpaceX and Tesla together, who cares
articles.desc: Oh sure, SpaceX's credit risk is pretty high because it's about to borrow another $40 billion to spend on Nvidia chips, but who cares about that? SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss a merger! The degree to which you find this merger compelling likely has to do with the degree to which […]

articles.title: MPC minutes: Two more interest rate hikes on cards, maybe even a third
articles.desc: Market participants and economists now expect a 25-bps increase in the December and February reviews. A further 25-bps increase in April isn't ruled out if crude oil prices remain persistently above $100. One basis point is a hundredth of a percentage point. "After the minutes were released, we think the probability of a consecutive hike in December has increased. Our terminal rate forecast is now at 6% for this hiking cycle and we expect the cycle to be rather shallow," Barclays said in a note.

articles.title: Centre flags land, green tape hurdles in infra projects
articles.desc: Delays in land acquisition and obtaining various environmental clearances have significantly impacted the progress of infrastructure projects. Although central agencies are improving approval times, states are still facing lengthy procedures for necessary permits. Utility shifting is also causing major disruptions, often taking longer than projected. The recent analysis reveals a considerable increase in costs due to pre-construction delays.

articles.title: Steep bill for AI buildout punishes Meta, other tech favorites
articles.desc: Investors sold shares of Meta Platforms and a wealth of companies central to the AI trade, a day after Meta -- one of the so-called hyperscalers spending billions to build data centers and other infrastructure supporting the AI boom -- said it would issue a new class of shares that will help it raise funds.

articles.title: SBI weighs data leak impact, alerts cyber cover provider
articles.desc: SBI may seek a claim under a Rs 1,425-crore cyber insurance policy with Oriental Insurance following a suspected leak of customer data, people familiar with the matter told ET. "SBI is in the process of notifying the insurer about the claim," said a person aware of the development.

articles.title: Rhode Island sues Meta over alleged tolerance for scam advertising
articles.desc: The suit, filed by Rhode Island Attorney General Peter Neronha in Providence Superior Court, accuses Meta of unlawfully profiting from and participating in the creation of billions of dollars in scam advertising - even as it assured its billions of users that it was working diligently to protect them.

articles.title: RBI asks banks, payment firms to forensically clear tech environments in case of a data breach
articles.desc: The RBI has asked financial entities to remove management and administrative interfaces from public internet access, enforce multi-factor authentication for administrative access, and restrict access to cloud and backend systems on a least-privilege basis. The measures include auditing source code, repositories, configuration files, client applications and cloud storage for exposed credentials, and immediately rotating and purging compromised credentials.

articles.title: Treasuries see best day in over a year as AI selloff revives haven demand
articles.desc: US Treasury bonds surged as a sharp selloff in AI-linked stocks revived demand for safe-haven assets. Treasury yields posted their biggest declines in more than a year, despite Brent crude rising above $112 a barrel. Investors also scaled back expectations for a December Fed rate hike amid growing concerns over AI spending and US growth.

articles.title: Swiggy CEO Sriharsha Majety says rival Blinkit has the stronger flywheel, aims to fix basics before expanding
articles.desc: He said Swiggy’s priority is a stable business with “the clearest line of sight to Ebitda zero,” and that it would not use its cash reserves to open new fronts simply because the money is available. “I think our first job is to build a stable, resilient business that has the clearest line of sight to EBITDA zero. The optionalities come after that,” he said on the call following the announcement of the company's September quarter results.

articles.title: Chana sowing holds key to pulses inflation
articles.desc: Chana, India's most consumed pulse, which is central to making everything from salty snacks to nutritious meals, needs adequate soil moisture and cool weather for a good crop. Sowing has started in some regions, but the progress is slow. State advisories to conserve water and shift to less water-intensive crops have added to concerns over winter sowing.

articles.title: India-Germany trade can surge 10-fold, says Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: India-Germany bilateral trade is expected to increase significantly, with aims of reaching 310 billion from 31 billion. Both countries are focused on co-creating and leveraging their complementary strengths for economic growth. The India-EU free trade agreement is anticipated to be signed soon and will facilitate mutual benefits. Minister Piyush Goyal emphasized the importance of trust and cooperation between the nations.

articles.title: GST return forms likely to be tweaked to curb mismatches
articles.desc: The government is looking to revamp GST return forms to minimise discrepancies between reported sales and tax payments. Draft forms will be available for public feedback starting November 1 and the changes take effect on April 1, 2027.

articles.title: Zuckerberg wins Meta deal to help him foot bill for possible California billionaire tax
articles.desc: The Meta boss had said he would exit the state over a wealth tax that has not yet come into force.

articles.title: Berlin Global Dialogue: EU inviting disaster through carbon tax, says Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: Piyush Goyal expressed concerns over the EU's carbon tax and numerous regulations impacting their steel industry. He warned that these measures could lead to increased costs and decreased competitiveness for EU businesses. Goyal highlighted that the high import duties and standards could harm the economy and raise the cost of living. He mentioned the reciprocal nature of trade regulations in response to the EU's actions.

articles.title: Neocloud short sellers rack up $6 billion as AI debt fears deepen
articles.desc: Short sellers betting against US neocloud and data centre companies have made about $6 billion in paper profits this month as AI debt fears trigger a sharp selloff. CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN, Applied Digital and Core Scientific face heavy short interest, highlighting growing concerns over debt-fuelled AI infrastructure spending.

articles.title: Pershing's Ackman sees a $1 trillion Israeli company within a decade
articles.desc: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman said he remained bullish on Israel’s economy and financial markets, predicting the country could produce a $1 trillion company within a decade. He highlighted Israel’s technology ecosystem, AI potential and growing ambitions to build global companies, while saying the country’s small population could become an advantage.

articles.title: Average long-term US mortgage rate eases to 7.32% in first pullback since late August
articles.desc: US mortgage rates eased for the first time since late August, with the average 30-year fixed rate falling to 7.32% from 7.40% last week, Freddie Mac said. The decline offers some relief to homebuyers, but borrowing costs remain elevated, with higher rates continuing to weigh on US home sales and demand.

articles.title: BlueStone reports Rs 4.4 crore loss in Q2 as operating revenue rises 45%
articles.desc: The company’s operating revenue rose 45% year-on-year (YoY) to Rs 745 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 513.6 crore a year earlier. Including other income of Rs 24.4 crore, BlueStone's total income stood at Rs 769 crore during the quarter.

articles.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
articles.desc: Indian equities fell sharply as rising crude prices, rupee weakness and global uncertainties pressured sentiment. Sensex lost over 460 points, Nifty declined 124 points, and BSE-listed companies lost Rs 3 lakh crore in market value.

articles.title: Yes Bank unlikely to pay AT1 bond coupons despite bond holders demand, sources say
articles.desc: Yes Bank has announced potential non-payment of coupons on additional tier-1 bonds this fiscal year following a Supreme Court decision that annulled the previous write-off of these bonds. Bondholders are advocating for repayment based on the court's ruling, which emphasizes unsettled dues. Nonetheless, Yes Bank maintains it has ultimate authority over coupon payments, raising concerns about its financial losses impacting these obligations.

articles.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
articles.desc: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

articles.title: Bridging the AI production gap: Over 100,000 Indian engineers trained to build with Gemini
articles.desc: India is seeing a significant shift in its technology workforce towards enterprise AI integration and solutions. The Build with Gemini initiative has trained over 100,000 developers and architects across several major organizations. This transition emphasizes the need for professionals skilled in engineering AI for production. Global System Integrators are crucial in facilitating this workforce transformation. The evolution aims to position India as a key player in AI architecture and engineering.

articles.title: Sebi warns investors against WhatsApp stock tips. Here's how you can avoid such traps
articles.desc: SEBI has cautioned investors against exclusive WhatsApp groups spreading unauthorised stock tips and fake profit claims. The regulator flagged astroturfing, overseas numbers, replacement groups and suspicious trading apps, urging investors to verify credentials and use registered intermediaries.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO stands alone as AI market jitters sideline others
articles.desc: Anthropic plans to move forward with its initial public offering next month, navigating a challenging IPO landscape. While many companies in the AI field have delayed their public listings due to fluctuating interest rates and significant market instabilities, investors still see potential in Anthropic as a leading tech contender. Concerns are arising from the recent Oura IPO regarding institutional investor interest, emphasizing the heightened scrutiny on AI investment strategies.

articles.title: NSDC raises Rs 4 crore through Social Stock Exchange for global skilling initiative
articles.desc: The funds raised will be used to provide skilling and employment opportunities to 600 youth from economically weaker other backward classes (OBC) households in Madhya Pradesh. The programme, with an estimated outlay of Rs 11.25 crore, aims to prepare 600 candidates for international employment opportunities, with 300 candidates earmarked for Japan and another 300 for Germany, the ministry of skills development and entrepreneurship said in a statement on Thursday.

articles.title: Parliamentary panel selects 25 subjects for review of urban development, Delhi projects
articles.desc: Under the Department of Urban Development, the committee will examine rainwater harvesting initiatives, legacy waste remediation, functioning of Smart City Integrated Command and Control Centres, and affordable rental housing projects.

articles.title: What is the PHP security vulnerability: The AI-found bug that made governments take websites offline
NCDEX launches NDEX and FINNDEX to expand into equity benchmarks
articles.desc: NCDEX has launched NDEX and FINNDEX, two equity benchmarks tracking 20 large, liquid Indian stocks and 15 financial sector companies. Their multi-factor methodology incorporates market capitalisation, trading activity, beta and volatility, with semiannual rebalancing.

articles.title: CreditAccess Grameen Q2 profit jumps fourfold to Rs 502 crore
articles.desc: CreditAccess Grameen reported a fourfold rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 502 crore, driven by higher income, lower expenses and credit costs. Improved asset quality prompted upward revisions to profitability guidance, while assets under management grew 19.5%.

articles.title: Tesla shares slip as capex cut clouds Musk’s AI, robotics ambitions
articles.desc: Tesla's shares dipped by 2% after it reduced its capital spending forecast for 2026, now predicting $20 billion instead of the previous $25 billion. This move has raised eyebrows among investors, especially with Tesla's stock already down 14% this year. Yet, it still boasts a higher valuation than many traditional automakers. Meanwhile, potential merger talks with SpaceX hint at regulatory hurdles that might prolong uncertainty for investors.

articles.title: Kolkata home registrations dip 12 per cent in Jan-Sep; larger flats gain share
articles.desc: In the first three quarters of 2026, home registrations in the Kolkata Metropolitan Area fell to 41,309, highlighting a year-on-year decline. Yet, there was an observable trend towards mid-sized and larger apartments. Specifically, September recorded 4,845 registrations, down from the previous year, with North Kolkata dominating 36% of the total shares. This data reveals a growing preference for spacious and practical living spaces among buyers.

articles.title: Hatsun Agro Product Q2 Results: Profit rises 5.6% on strong sales
articles.desc: Hatsun Agro Product reported a notable growth in net profit for the September quarter, reaching Rs 115.69 crore, up from Rs 109.54 crore from last year. Total income also surged to Rs 2,902.49 crore, showcasing strong sales amidst industry hurdles. The company emphasizes enhancing direct consumer relationships and expanding its market footprint in Maharashtra and Odisha, while continuing to invest in its procurement, processing, and distribution systems.

articles.title: Anthropic unveils Claude Duet AI agent app
articles.desc: Anthropic on Thursday unveiled Claude Duet, a standalone AI agent app designed to act as a proactive assistant for professionals and small-business owners, as rivals such as OpenAI and Meta race to develop AI agents that can complete work autonomously on users' behalf.

articles.title: YouTuber arrested after popular Indian finance influencer's suicide
articles.desc: V Harish, who ran the hugely popular Instagram account "Finance with Harish", was found dead on Tuesday.

articles.title: Indian Bank raises deposit rates by 15 basis points
articles.desc: Indian Bank managing director Binod Kumar had said earlier that the bank does not have surplus liquidity as it shed Rs 10,000 crore of bulk deposits and slowed term deposits mobilisation during the second quarter while it raised $2.3 billion (about Rs 21,000 crore) of foreign currency non-resident-bank (FCNR-B) deposits using the regulatory window.

articles.title: Cognizant acquires DyFlex Solutions to enhance AI and SAP transformation capabilities
articles.desc: Cognizant Technology Solutions has signed an agreement to acquire DyFlex Solutions, enhancing its AI and SAP capabilities. This acquisition is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals. DyFlex specializes in SAP transformation and is based in Australia and New Zealand. The deal marks Cognizant’s third acquisition in 2026 as it seeks to expand its services.

articles.title: US stocks today: US stocks slide as AI spending jitters hit Nasdaq, oil prices rebound
articles.desc: US stocks opened lower on Thursday as renewed concerns over the outlook for artificial intelligence weighed on growth stocks. Tesla and Meta earnings failed to ease AI-related jitters, while rising oil prices added to market pressure. The Nasdaq fell 1.48%, while the S&P 500 and Dow also declined at the open.

articles.title: Swiggy to shift to inventory model starting Q3 FY27, eyes 80 bps Instamart margin boost
articles.desc: The transition is likely to improve its quick commerce arm Instamart’s contribution margin by around 80 basis points once fully implemented. It will also give the Bengaluru-based company better control over assortment, pricing, product availability, and day-to-day operations.

articles.title: IBM falls as analysts question staying power of software rebound
articles.desc: IBM shares fell 6.5% in premarket trading on Thursday, as analysts said part of the company's third-quarter software rebound was driven by deals delayed from the previous quarter, raising questions about how sustainable the boost would be.

articles.title: Record galore! Jio IPO claims crown for highest QIB demand among India’s 5 largest issues, edges past NSE
articles.desc: Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,213-crore IPO attracted 12.87 times QIB subscription, surpassing NSE’s institutional demand. Overall subscription reached 5.36 times by Day 2, with a strong grey market premium and positive brokerage recommendations.

articles.title: US stocks 2026: Moderna, SanDisk lead top 10 gainers delivering up to 734% returns
articles.desc: Ten US stocks with market caps above $5 billion have seen share prices more than triple in 2026, delivering returns up to 734%. Healthcare and tech sectors dominate, led by biotechnology firm Moderna and flash memory maker SanDisk, highlighting strong momentum across biotech and established tech majors like Dell.

articles.title: SoFi targets idle crypto cash with interest-bearing tokenized deposit
articles.desc: SoFi Technologies has launched an innovative tokenized deposit product that offers an attractive 4.2% annual interest rate. Funds deposited are insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation for amounts up to $250,000 per depositor. This strategic move enables customers to prepare for crypto acquisitions while still earning interest, rather than letting cash sit idle.

articles.title: Colgate-Palmolive India Q2 Results: Profit rises 4.3% to Rs 341.6 crore
articles.desc: Colgate-Palmolive India Ltd has reported a 4.3% increase in net profit for the September quarter. The company achieved a net profit of Rs 341.57 crore compared to Rs 327.51 crore last year. Sales increased by 12.22% to Rs 1,691.57 crore in this quarter. The gross margin expanded by 40 basis points year-on-year, reflecting cost management strategies and pricing actions.

articles.title: Sebi allows margin relief against early pay-in of securities for subsequent trades
articles.desc: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has announced a new directive that eases margin requirements for clients with a net sell obligation. This policy is particularly applicable when early pay-in requests are accepted by the clearing corporation, allowing clients to execute trades more efficiently. No margin will be collected on future trades up to the value of accepted early pay-in securities.

articles.title: Meta falls as investors balance Muse growth with rising AI costs
articles.desc: Shares of Meta Platforms fell about 3% in premarket trading on Thursday, as investors weighed the benefits of the company's fast-growing AI agent business against the mounting costs of funding its ambitious AI expansion.

articles.title: Union Pacific's third-quarter profit rises on pricing strength
articles.desc: Union Pacific showcased impressive third-quarter adjusted profit, primarily fueled by increased fuel surcharge revenue and solid core pricing strategies. The boost in operating revenue reflects their commitment to maintaining pricing discipline and enhancing operational efficiencies. Despite the hurdles posed by geopolitical-driven energy price hikes, US railroads have effectively sustained profitability, benefiting from improved service reliability that attracted new freight volumes while keeping existing customers engaged.

articles.title: eMudhra to exit global SSL/TLS certificate business after controversy
articles.desc: Digital trust services provider eMudhra on Thursday said that it would voluntarily withdraw from the global SSL/TLS certificate business, following an incident where its certificates were found to have vulnerabilities.

articles.title: HPCL Q2 Results: Profit slips 6% YoY to Rs 3,625 crore, revenue jumps 26%
articles.desc: HPCL reported Q2FY27 net profit of Rs 3,625 crore, recovering from a previous-quarter loss. Revenue rose 26.1% year-on-year, refining margins surged, fuel sales increased, and investments advanced infrastructure expansion, innovation, and green energy initiatives.

articles.title: Mahindra Lifespace Q2 profit down 66 pc to Rs 16 cr
articles.desc: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd experienced a substantial 66 percent drop in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 2026, with profits falling to Rs 16.34 crore compared to Rs 47.91 crore last year. However, total income saw remarkable growth, reaching Rs 104.02 crore, up from Rs 33.06 crore. For the first half of this fiscal year, net profit saw a minor uptick to Rs 101.

articles.title: Indian bonds tumble on oil surge, RBI rate hike fears
articles.desc: Indian government bonds experienced a decline as the benchmark yield exceeded 7.45% on Thursday. Oil prices rose significantly, reaching $112.50 per barrel in Asian trading amid geopolitical tensions. The Reserve Bank of India has raised its repo rate to 5.50%, indicating a potential for further hikes. Inflation concerns are mounting, with expectations for retail inflation to surpass the central bank's tolerance limit.

articles.title: India's JSW Paints eyes 4, 5-year debt to refinance acquisition-led funding, bankers say
articles.desc: India's JSW Paints is likely to raise funds through issuance of bonds maturing in four years and five years and should go ahead with the sale in the next couple of weeks, two merchant bankers with direct knowledge of the matter said on Thursday.

articles.desc: India's trade minister Piyush Goyal announced that the EU FTA is expected to be signed soon. After signing, the FTA could be operational within four to five months. The deal aims to boost market access and bilateral trade between India and the EU significantly. Goyal emphasized the importance of collaboration in various sectors to maximize mutual benefits.

articles.title: Market wrap: Bajaj Finance, Cipla, Nestle India, Eternal top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday
articles.desc: Indian equity markets fell for a third consecutive session as weak global cues and sustained selling weighed on sentiment. The Nifty 50 declined 0.54% to 22,688, while the Sensex dropped 0.62% to 73,249.

articles.title: Global Market: Japanese banks see rising corporate loan demand ahead of BOJ meeting
articles.desc: Japanese banks report rising corporate funding demand despite the Bank of Japan’s 1.25% interest rate, reinforcing expectations of further monetary tightening. Persistent inflation risks, resilient lending and government concerns will shape the central bank’s upcoming policy decision.

articles.title: UBS acquires 4.8% stake in wealth manager 360 ONE WAM through warrant exercise
articles.desc: UBS has acquired a 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM by exercising 2.05 crore warrants and paying around Rs 1,584 crore. The transaction follows a partnership announced in April 2025, under which UBS agreed to sell its Indian onshore wealth management business to the Mumbai-based firm for about $32 million.

articles.title: GST reforms from November 1 to simplify e-commerce seller registration, fast-track refunds
articles.desc: Starting November 1, the government plans to simplify GST registration for small e-commerce sellers. These reforms intend to reduce compliance burdens and facilitate faster refund processes. New measures will streamline registration by allowing sellers to declare e-commerce warehouses as their Principal Place of Business. Automated systems will issue refunds without officer intervention to improve operational efficiency. A minimum threshold for issuing show-cause notices will also be introduced to lower litigation.

articles.title: China-Europe rail and India’s long road to Eurasia
articles.desc: India is focusing on connectivity initiatives such as the International North-South Transport Corridor and the IMEC. Geopolitical tensions have challenged India's ambitions to establish reliable connectivity with Europe. In contrast, the China-Europe freight network significantly expands trade routes across Eurasia. The expansion provides multiple routes and helps mitigate disruptions in maritime transport. A shift in India-China relations may further enhance India's connectivity options with Eurasian markets.

articles.title: India's interest rate gap with G7 in focus as RBI weighs inflation risks: Report
articles.desc: India's monetary policy is now shaped by the interest rate gap with major developed economies and rising inflation. The Reserve Bank of India is concerned about inflation risks and input cost increases. Recent GDP growth figures indicate resilience supported by strong private consumption and exports. YES Bank predicts a cumulative rate hike of 50 basis points by the RBI.

articles.title: Domestic cos need strategic approach to tap India-Europe FTA gains: FICCI
articles.desc: Indian companies must adopt a strategic approach to fully leverage the European free trade agreement benefits, as tariff concessions alone may not suffice. The focus should be on product quality, market penetration, and building significant relationships with European buyers. Compliance with European standards will be crucial for export success, particularly for small enterprises.

articles.desc: Motilal Oswal Financial Services and Calliope Capital Advisors have put in their bids for shares in Ola Electric Mobility's latest rights issue, which is set to raise Rs 1,000 crore by offering partly paid-up shares at Rs 27 each. The rights issue commenced on Thursday and will conclude on October 30, with crucial payment details outlined.

articles.title: Meta beats expectations but legal penalties hit profit amid AI race
articles.desc: Meta beat investor expectations for third-quarter revenue on Wednesday as it doubles down on a global AI race but the social media giant's profits took a hit due to an $18 billion legal settlement with nearly all US states. The company reported $9.86 billion in profits from July to September, almost 50 percent below investor expectations, which Meta said was dragged down by a $9.9 billion charge related to the settlement.

articles.title: X Community Notes 'failed' to flag US election falsehoods, study says
articles.desc: A crowd-sourced verification system used by Elon Musk's X failed to flag a vast majority of false claims related to the US midterm elections -- including those promoted by the billionaire -- a study said Wednesday. "X's crowdsourced fact-checking program failed to flag 93.1 percent of false claims related to the US midterm elections," NewsGuard said.
